{{Top|leg}}
'''Hoverest cabinets''' were a specialized medical system developed to treat burn victims in the years following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Suspended inside the chamber by small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]], the patient would be treated with a fine mist of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], which sprayed into the chamber.
